title: usage.recorded payload v1 (PROPOSED, feasibility spike)
description: One metered use by a holder: an LLM completion, a storage snapshot, an API call. No postings: this is a measurement, not money; rating it into dollars (and any postings) is a later, separate event. Labels carry the bounded axes to group by (model, region); the numbers are here, never in labels. Whole numbers are JSON integers; fractional or money-like values are decimal strings with a fixed number of places, never floats. The raw event (prompts, messages) is not here: it stays in the input store under this event's `cause`, with the mapping's personal paths removed. Must not carry `command`: the replay reads a payload with a `command` as an engine mutation.

payload_schema.description: The version of this payload schema (usage.recorded.v1.json). The envelope's `v` versions the envelope, not the payload; the event_type + this number name the schema file.

mapping_digest.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the mapping file that produced this fact. `mapping` names it; the digest proves the file a reader holds is the one that ran.

raw_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of the raw source event with the mapping's personal paths removed. The redacted raw is stored apart under this hash (content-addressed, so identical events share one object); with it and the mapping, the fact can be re-derived.

mapping.description: The mapping that produced this fact, e.g. openai/llm.completion@v1.

request_id.description: The producer's own id. Also inside `idem`; here so a reader does not parse idem.

units.description: The unit of each quantity, by the same names.

late.description: Present when the event reached ingest after the mapping's late threshold (event_time and ingest_time are far apart).
